derivation: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero;

occurrences.text: The son of Geber, in Ramoth–gilead; to him pertained the towns of Jair the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead; to him also pertained the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, threescore great cities with walls and brasen bars:
